property_summary: For any caller and any amount, only the contract owner can change betLimit via AdjustBetAmounts; the mutant that removes the onlyOwner check allows a non-owner caller to change betLimit for some inputs.
change_summary: Relax onlyOwner modifier to allow any caller (remove the require), so AdjustBetAmounts can be called by non-owners and change betLimit when invoked by others.
